item.title: Apex Live
item.description: A local-first Formula 1 timing wall. It turns the public F1 timing stream into a dense race console with gaps, intervals, sectors and mini-sectors, tyre stints, weather, Race Control, team radio and live championship projections. Every race ever run is mirrored into a local SQLite database for historical context. It runs on your own machine, not on a server, and it is explicit about whether what you're looking at is live, delayed, replayed or synthetic.
